newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dainippon Screen says to build plant.
newsitem.headline: Dainippon Screen says to build plant.

text.p: Dainippon Screen Manufacturing Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it would invest about seven billion yen to build a plant in Japan to produce semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
Construction of the plant, to be built in Shiga prefecture in central Japan, will start in September, the company said in a statement.
Operations are expected to start in October 1998, it said.
Output in the initial year of operation is expected at 50 units a month, it said, adding that sales in the first year are expected at 50 billion yen.
The company decided to build the plant in anticipation of a shift to next-generation semiconductors and 300-mm wafers, Dainippon Screen said.
